top_events.label: ICE agents detain two at Seattle airport
top_events.summary: Video shows masked immigration agents forcibly detaining two people at Seattle airport, raising concerns over tactics. Officials condemned the arrests as horrific and chilling.

top_events.summary: Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued across California as powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres were recorded throughout the week.
